claim_repairs.historical_line: External Windows symptom after V2.13.4N: deployment reached `DEPLOY_ASSET_GIT_ARCHIVE PASS` and `DEPLOY_STAGING_SELF_COPY_PREVENTION PASS`, then failed with `Das Laufwerk wurde nicht gefunden. Ein Laufwerk mit dem Namen " C" ist nicht vorhanden.` The sequence proves that the git archive existed and the failure occurred while treating the returned asset path as a PowerShell path. Root cause: PowerShell functions emit all uncaptured pipeline output, so helper functions such as `New-GitArchiveAsset` returned both internal `Invoke-GitChecked` text and the intended `$asset`. The resulting array was coerced into a space-joined string like `<path> <path>`, which PowerShell path parsing could misread as an invalid drive prefix.
